script_text: Stop, Aries, the cosmos is violently shaking your foundation tonight. Saturn is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Mars right now, creating friction in your 7th House of Partnerships. This intense aspect brings frustrating delays and power struggles with the people closest to you, forcing you to endure pressure before any breakthrough. If you are taken, watch for a sudden argument over finances that could damage your bond. If single, this square pushes you toward a toxic connection that requires immediate avoidance. However, Jupiter is trining your Sun in the 10th House of Career, promising a sudden promotion opportunity. This alignment ensures that your professional status receives a massive boost, overriding the partnership struggles. Avoid letting your Fire element sabotage this cosmic gift, as a hidden blessing is securing your financial future. Subscribe so you don't miss this pivotal shift in your life.
